podcast.title: Bowie's Core Band Member
podcast.body: Carlos Alomar was the guitarist in David Bowie's core band during the recording of *Low* and *Heroes*. "La banda principal estaba formada por Carlos Alomar a la guitarra."

srcs.episode: El proyecto que salvó a David Bowie. La trilogía de Berlín

podcast.title: Inspired by "Shame Shame Shame"
podcast.body: Carlos Alomar was inspired by Shirley & Company's "Shame Shame Shame" to rework a song he and David Bowie had been working on, titled "Footstump," into "Fame." "That's the song that inspired David Bowie, John Lennon, and Carlos Alema to re-work a song Bowie and Alema had been working on called Footstump him into fame."
